mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_tokens (user_id, purpose, token_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{purpose}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE email_tokens SET used_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND used_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM email_tokens WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND created_at > #{since}
